metadata.title: High Dose Ifosfamide Therapy – 21 day
metadata.indication: Recurrent/primary refractory Ewing sarcoma or relapsed osteosarcoma.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Organ-function values or categories are optional; omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

official_indication_contexts.description: Recurrent or primary refractory Ewing sarcoma

notes: No paediatric/adult extrapolation or automatic supportive-drug dosing.
Absolute bilirubin adapter uses actual result and local ULN, never assumedULN20.
IE neurotoxicity occurrence plan and high-dose grade≥3 stop remain distinct.
Source-specific eligibility gap for osteosarcoma remains explicit.

ifosfamide_product_reconciliation.source_scope: Named Mitoxana 1 g product; actual local supplied product requires verification

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00680 Version 2. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Source reconciled in SACTCheck v0.59.0; independent Consultant and oncology-pharmacy validation pending.

indications.description: Recurrent/primary refractory Ewing sarcoma or relapsed osteosarcoma; detailed osteosarcoma eligibility requires specialist reconciliation.

treatment.schedule_summary: Ifosfamide3000mg/m² over24hours on Days1–5 every21days, maximum4cycles; support continues after the infusion.

encephalopathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Current assessment: Distinguish altered alertness, confusion, hallucinations or seizures from peripheral sensory, motor or autonomic neuropathy. Record the exact event, objective findings, functional effects and interventions using the named-event criteria. Current CNS toxicity has its own separate Yes/No assessment.
encephalopathy_grade.grading_source_label: NCCP neurological action table; grading edition not specified
encephalopathy_grade.source_grading_note: The source supplies neurological action thresholds, not a complete severity scale. Document the exact named central or peripheral event and apply its verified criteria; the NCCP table does not specify a grading edition. A broad grade does not itself establish current CNS toxicity.

current_ifosfamide_cns_toxicity.label: Current suspected or established ifosfamide CNS toxicity (altered alertness/confusion, hallucinations or seizure)
current_ifosfamide_cns_toxicity.assessment_guidance: Assess current mental status and central symptoms urgently; consider metabolic, infective and medicine causes. Peripheral neuropathy alone does not establish CNS toxicity. This is a current-event assessment, not a severity grade or a decision on future rechallenge.

eligibility: Exact listed indication; adequate hepatic, renal and marrow function.
Ewing: confirmed histology and progression/recurrence; primary refractory includes progression during first-line therapy or within12weeks after it.
No source numeric age/ECOG cutoff; do not invent one. Osteosarcoma is listed but lacks separate detailed eligibility prose.
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component
Pregnancy or breastfeeding where prohibited by the current source
Regimen-specific exclusions encoded in the interactive assessment
monitoring: FBC, renal and liver profiles at baseline and before each cycle.
Neurological assessment before every ifosfamide dose; check haematuria before each dose and every8hours on treatment days.
Strict fluid balance, urine output and daily weight; hydration extends24hours after ifosfamide ends.
dose_modifications: Current count delay always overrides future percentage discussion.
Ifosfamide CrCl<50 or haemodialysis: individual clinical decision; severe hepatic impairment not recommended.
Exact source-specific neurotoxicity management; retain prior severe/stop history.
All concurrent percentage/history/organ adjustments require one reconciled prescription; no multiplication or automatic re-escalation.
